title: Cachivane Paris Leather
description: Cinematic European fashion brand film capturing timeless pebble-grain leather craftsmanship, golden hardware details, and Parisian street movement.
overview: Directed an elevated luxury commercial for the Cachivane signature leather handbag, featuring an elegant model in tailored tailoring navigating Parisian architectural streets with macro texture closeups.
challenge: On-location luxury filming in Paris typically demands city filming permits, insurance, high-end cinema camera rigs, and high talent fees.
solution: Generated high-fashion lighting and hyper-consistent handbag geometry across cinematic walk cycles using Runway Gen-3 camera tracking and custom architectural LoRAs.
